newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: U.N. correspondents award four scholarships.
newsitem.headline: U.N. correspondents award four scholarships.

text.p: Journalists from South Africa, Vietnam, Bosnia and India were awarded scholarships on Tuesday by the U.N. Correspondents Association to enable them to travel to New York to cover the annual General Assembly session opening in September.
Selected by the Association's Dag Hammarskjoeld Memorial Scholarship Fund were:
Marco Granelli, Pretoria News; Nguyen Manh Hung, Vietnam Investment Review; Melisa Dedovic, National Weekly Ljiljan, Sarajevo; and Ashutosh Gupta, AAJ Tak TV-Today, New Delhi.

Since its establishment in 1961, in memory of the late U.N. Secretary-General Dag Hammarskjoeld, who was killed in an aircrash in Africa, the Fund has enabled 126 young working journalists from 66 countries to cover U.N. General Assembly sessions.
